notes.title: Vermitron is now available on iOS and Google Play!
notes.content:
Hello there,

It's happening!

Vermitron is now available on iOS and Google Play! 🥳

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vermitron/id6450840675

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.clickteam.vermitron


Thanks to Clickteam for the great work on the port. You guys rock!

Happy Gaming! ːwinter2019happyyulː

cheers,
FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - July 10, 2023
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Added "B" button support on the controller for exit in the Terminal.
Added "Left Stick" support on the controller for move in the Terminal.
Changed / Limited the maximum frequency of attack sound effects on all the turrets and enemies. (changed from tatatatatatatata to ta-ta-ta-ta...) :D

Happy gaming and have a nice day!

cheers,
@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - April 6, 2023
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Added more info about Turrets and PowerUps + some useful Kitty tips into the How To Play section.
Fixed Player collision with doors. Sometimes the door wouldn't open on the first try.
Fixed / Changed player collision with enemies. Player hitbox is now smaller.
Fixed "larva bug". Sometimes the larva didn't turn into a small worm.

Happy gaming and have a nice day!

cheers,
@FobTi

notes.title: They Came From The Sky 2 is Out of Early Access!
notes.content:
I'm really excited to announce that They Came From The Sky 2 is Out of Early Access!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38832276/e1c3797a80e8fd136e2bb5f153c8e18c9db97aa9.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2080010/They_Came_From_the_Sky_2/

Thanks much to everyone who was supporting TCFTS2 during the Early Access. Thanks for all your suggestions and feedback, you're all awesome!

And special thanks to my lovely wife Silvia for her GREAT patience :)

I will continue to gather your suggestions to improve the game. If anyone has good ideas about what they'd like to see, I'd love to hear them. :)


Have fun, folks!

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - April 8, 2021
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:


Changed Max life from 3 to 5

Added NEW PowerUp: Big Heart  (increases max life +1)

Added NEW Enemy: Purple Slime (drops Big Heart) 


It's just a small update but useful, i think. :)

Happy gaming! :)

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - February 27, 2021
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Added: New Power-Up "Freeze". (freeze all enemies on the screen for a short while)

Added: Skip button for skipping the talking scene in the last BOSS stage.

Fixed: Final Boss fight. (sometimes the boss did not use all the attacks)

Changed: Amount of ammo for all weapons.

Changed: Increased speed when you walking with the watering-can. (+10 speed)


Happy gaming! :)

@FobTi

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - February 5, 2021
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Changed: Coins and Energy are now permanently visible.

Changed: HUD is now visible even if you are in the Terminal.

Added flashing for PowerPlant icon if you don't have enough power.

Added shorter time for bomb explosion and bigger hitbox.

Added bigger damage for bombard tower.

Changed price for bombard tower from 5 to 7.

Added a little bit more HP for all the towers. (+5)

Added 4 new building places on the Floor 3.

Changed graphics of building info.


New Upgrades and Power-Ups coming soon!


Enjoy the game! :)

notes.title: Update Patch Notes - January 27, 2021
notes.content:
The following updates have been implemented:

Fixed Pause function in the terminal.

Added short invulnerability when entering to a new room.

Changed the way how to take a watering-can from automatic to manual. (Press action button to take it) This give you time to explore more rooms or build a better defense.

CONTINUE button are selected by default at the start of the title screen, if the game has been saved.

Added flashing FX for hearts on the HUD panel if you lost your health.

Enjoy the game! :)
